rows.grounds: instrumental of rahasya with demonstrative force; refers to the secret method just indicated
vocative address to Pārvatī; compound of cāru and aṅga
expresses the result produced by the secret
accusative object indicating the form attained; compound of viṣṇu and vigraha

items.question: What divine form is attained through this secret, O beautiful-limbed one?
premises: A specific secret method is being invoked.
The beautiful-limbed one is the addressed recipient.
Through this secret a Viṣṇu-form arises.
items.inference: Therefore, employing this secret results in the attainment of a Viṣṇu-form.
uncertainties: jāyate may indicate being born as or coming to possess the stated form.
items.plain_english: O beautiful-limbed one, by this secret a Viṣṇu-form is attained.
